title.narrative: Girls of A Feather St. Lucia Inc.

description.narrative: Based in Saint Lucia, Girls of a Feather is a youth-led organization shifting the narrative about girls whose lives are shaped by societal and systemic failures depriving them of opportunities to live safe and fulfilling lives. They work with girls to co-create a solution that specifically meets their needs; using evidence and collecting data to inform best practices; increasing the availability and accessibility of youth-friendly psycho-social support; engaging with high level stakeholders to influence policy changes; and generating movement building through local and regional collaboration. The grant will support the following specific priorities: - Organizational costs such as staff salaries, bookkeeper fees, internet, phone expenses, rent, utilities, software, equipment maintenance, and training for their staff and members; - Meeting and workshop-related costs, including transportation, meals, facilitator/ trainer fees; and others; - Counselling services; - Marketing and publicity.
